calculation_handling.description: An application submitted on or prior to July 22, 2022 that qualifies under the 230.90.15.1 to 230.90.15.4 transitions must comply with the former Chapter 970 bicycle parking regulations.
calculation_handling.gaps: Application dates and transition eligibility are not held; the former Chapter 970 path is never evaluated.

instrument.citation: regulations 970.30.1(2), 970.30.15.5(3), (4), Table 970.30.15.5  Bicycle Parking Space Rates, and regulation 970.30.15.5(5)

calculation_handling.description: An application submitted after July 22, 2022 and on or prior to March 31, 2025 that qualifies under the 230.90.15.1 to 230.90.15.4 transitions must comply with the former Chapter 970 bicycle parking regulations.
calculation_handling.gaps: Application dates and transition eligibility are not held; the former Chapter 970 path is never evaluated.

230.90.15(1).explanation: A project whose application was submitted on or before July 22, 2022 and qualifies under the transition rules must follow the earlier bicycle parking rules in Chapter 970 instead of the current ones.

230.90.15(2).explanation: A project whose application was submitted after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025 and qualifies under the transition rules must follow the earlier bicycle parking rules in Chapter 970, including their rates table.
